en: Elena,
what an incredible match you just played
to send yourself to your first US Open final.
After the first set,
how were you able to reset and come out
and play such good tennis in the second
and third?
I feel like first set it was still a good start,
you know, it was just one break
and of course there is nerves.
Koko, she is a great player.
It's always tough to play against her.
Even
if sometimes her first serve doesn't go,
the second one is so heavy
that it's difficult to dictate the rallies.
And yeah, I just took a deep breath,
you know, was trying to talk positive
with myself and just told myself that I need
to fight and try to show good tennis.
In the third, you served for the match,
got broken, and came back
and played an incredible return game.
Did you lose any confidence at 5-3
or were you still pretty confident
at your abilities to return at 5-4?
It was such a close set
and I feel like I got a little bit lucky
on this
on her serve couple deep returns,
one mistake from her.
It went quickly my way
and then I know you guys wanted Koko
to win and I think it
was a real battle and
as I said few moments really it went my way
and in the end I mean I was just trying
to still be focused try to stay aggressive
and somehow won the match.
Well well great job in winning the match.
In the final,
you will face a familiar opponent
in a Grand Slam final in Aryna Sabalenka.
What are your thoughts
on that upcoming incredible women's final?
Well,
she's I mean she's unbelievable player
and she was playing really well today,
I feel like.
And I definitely need to step
my game up serve much better,
start to serve much better than today
and stay aggressive go for the shots
because I know whenever you get
opportunity you need to really go
for your shots especially
with Aryna.
So yeah just try to enjoy.
I think I did maximum on this tournament
already especially doubting
if I'm going to be able to play here.
So yeah, I just tried to enjoy.
